result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but one visible content error stands out: a discount badge reading "-0%" on the partially shown card near the bottom.

issues.description: A discount badge displays "-0%", which is nonsensical and looks like a broken or missing promotion value.
issues.suggestion: Only render the badge when there is a real positive discount, and format it as a positive value such as "20% off"; hide the badge entirely when the discount is zero.
